proof_body:
by
  intro a b ha hb
  have hab : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha hb
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (a * b) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hab
  have hss : Real.sqrt (a * b) ^ 2 = a * b := Real.sq_sqrt hab.le
  constructor
  · generalize Real.sqrt (a * b) = s at hs hss
    refine ⟨s / a, div_pos hs ha, ?_⟩
    have e1 : a * (s / a) = s := by field_simp
    have e2 : b / (s / a) = s := by
      field_simp
      linarith
    rw [e1, e2]
    ring
  · rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have huv : (a * x) * (b / x) = a * b := by field_simp
    have hu : 0 < a * x := mul_pos ha hx
    have hv : 0 < b / x := div_pos hb hx
    have h : Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ (a * x + b / x) / 2 :=
      Real.sqrt_le_iff.2 ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * x - b / x)]⟩
    linarith
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → IsLeast {y : ℝ | ∃ x : ℝ, 0 < x ∧ y = a * x + b / x} (2 * Real.sqrt (a * b))
